title: derivation reproducibility
summary: For a Tarium project's published derived dataset, ontology specimen or gallery artifact, record the public input identities and relevant transformation versions, parameters or steps sufficient to reproduce the published result where reproduction is promised.
statement: For a Tarium project's published derived dataset, ontology specimen or gallery artifact, record the public input identities and relevant transformation versions, parameters or steps sufficient to reproduce the published result where reproduction is promised.
rationale: Independent, checkable coverage of an identified public Tarium resource concern not fully specified by previously selected obligations. General requirements remain in place and are not duplicated.

conditions: An owner-authorized independent public Tarium project uses or publishes the relevant dataset, ontology, artifact or workflow.
exceptions: No new data collection or external publication is authorized merely by this obligation; excluded resources need no invented substitute.
